{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check the revenue column format
print('\nSample of revenue column:')
print(data['revenue'].head(10))

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
# Look for commas in the revenue strings
has_commas = data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f'Number of revenue entries with commas: {has_commas.sum()}')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
# First, ensure all revenue values are valid numbers
# Replace commas with empty string, then convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify the conversion
print('\nSample of cleaned revenue:')
print(data['revenue_clean'].head(10))"}
